text:
maya: starting a narrow canary for auth-router -> v2026.4 at 1% (change window 14:00-16:00UTC). watch latency, 5xx, and cache OOMs for 12m. deploy-bot will post events. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: service=auth-router tag=v2026.4 percent=1 initiator=maya window=14-16UTC

alex: proposed rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >=0.5% for 3m OR p99 > 450ms for 3m OR KV cache OOM spike. Agree?

maya: yes. add a note to run diagnostics on any cache-related traces.

sam: tailing telemetry now: https://telemetry/auth-router/live?tag=v2026.4 . initial p95 up ~8ms but no errors.

lina: pinning fallback v2026.3-stable at standby. deploy-bot will create it.

deploy-bot: executed: create-fallback service=auth-router fallback=v2026.3-stable status=ready pinned=true

alex: rough sample traces show kv_miss correlates to higher tail. we'll watch.

sam: small p99 blip at 4m (p99=462ms) but only for a handful of kv_miss requests, no 5xx.

maya: decision: hold at 1% until 14:12UTC. sam, keep streaming. alex prepare rollback checklist in case it worsens.

alex: prepping rollback steps and smoke test quick-run.

sam: continuing observation. dashboard shows no sustained spike after a quick mitigation (shortened seq for canary traffic).

maya: interim hold confirmed. will call go/no-go at 14:12UTC. tag @oncall if anything breaches thresholds. :thumbsup:
